body: T_ping <= 120s is the requirement, not a target. Detection latency is N_miss x T_ping. Stating a grace in absolute seconds independently of T_ping lets the two drift and re-introduces the timer anti-pattern OB-4 retired. RECOMMEND T_ping=120s max, N_miss=3, detection <= 360s, with BOTH values carried as data on the NoConfidence record so a verdict can be read against the policy that produced it. No new type is needed: L0's NoConfidence(Domain,Term,Subject,Watcher,Reason,GraceMisses,PingInterval,ObservedAt) already carries both fields.

body: An elector daemon MUST fold the SHARED board, never a per-user replica, and MUST refuse to answer rather than answer from an incomplete record set. Rationale, measured: a replica short by ONE prepare inverts the fleet's leader status - the logic is correct, the input is one marginal record short, so the daemon correctly finds no quorum and correctly reports leader:None while the shared board shows the term decided. If each host folds a slightly different subset of ballots, hosts disagree about who leads FOREVER and every host is certain and correct on its own evidence. That is the F-1 generator. Corollary: a leader claim MUST name the board it was folded from (FR-33) and a daemon MUST expose its resolved root so a reader can tell which board answered.

Prepares for ariellas: shared 6 (=quorum), replica 5. guardian@gavris's prepare at the SAME timestamp IS present, so a simultaneous pair was half-committed - batch atomicity, not lag. Writes were unaffected: max record id identical (000075) on both.
title: The elector MUST read the shared board, and its record set MUST be complete or it must refuse

Re-measured 10 minutes later, the missing prepare had ARRIVED and ynetd elect now returns Decided/term 6/broker@ariellas/6 of 6, matching the shared board. It was LAG with uneven intra-pair delivery, and it CONVERGED. Nothing was lost. THE REQUIREMENT ITSELF IS UNCHANGED AND IS IF ANYTHING STRONGER: an elector MUST read the shared board or refuse, because during the lag window it is not silent - it is CONFIDENTLY WRONG, reporting leader:None while the shared board shows the term decided. A requirement that only holds if a specific mechanism is true is a weak requirement; this one holds under lag, under half-commit, and under loss.
